notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Please go to an emergency department now. Do not drive yourself — have someone else take you, and call 911 if no safe ride is available or if you feel faint, weaker or worse. Black tarry stools with lightheadedness on standing can mean active bleeding in the gut with meaningful blood loss. If you vomit blood or become confused or short of breath, call 911; if you lose consciousness, anyone with you should call 911. I recommend Counsel stay involved in this thread for follow-up after you are seen.
